title: Zechariah Chapter 5 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Zechariah chapter 5 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Zechariah Chapter 5 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Zechariah Chapter 5.

questions.question: What did Zechariah see when he lifted up his eyes in Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: Zechariah saw a flying roll when he lifted up his eyes as recorded in Zechariah 5:1.

questions.question: What were the length and breadth of the flying roll Zechariah saw?
questions.explanation: The flying roll was described as twenty cubits in length and ten cubits in breadth in Zechariah 5:2.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 5, what does the flying roll represent?
options: The curse that goes forth over the whole earth
questions.correctAnswer: The curse that goes forth over the whole earth
questions.explanation: The flying roll is identified as the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth in Zechariah 5:3.

questions.question: What will happen to those who steal or swear falsely, according to the flying roll's curse?
options: They shall be cut off according to the flying roll
They shall be given a warning
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be cut off according to the flying roll
questions.explanation: The curse states that everyone who steals or swears falsely shall be cut off on either side according to the flying roll in Zechariah 5:3.

questions.question: Where will the curse enter and remain, as stated in Zechariah 5?
options: Into the house of the thief and the house of him that swears falsely
Into the field of the farmer
questions.correctAnswer: Into the house of the thief and the house of him that swears falsely
questions.explanation: The curse will enter and remain in the midst of the house of the thief and him that swears falsely as per Zechariah 5:4.

questions.question: True or False: The flying roll will consume the house with the timber and stones thereof.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:4 says the flying roll shall consume the house with its timber and stones.

questions.question: What did the angel tell Zechariah to do after the flying roll vision?
options: Lift up his eyes again and see what goes forth
questions.correctAnswer: Lift up his eyes again and see what goes forth
questions.explanation: The angel instructed Zechariah to lift up his eyes and see what is going forth in Zechariah 5:5.

questions.question: What is described as going forth after the flying roll vision?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:6 says that what goes forth is an ephah.

questions.question: In Zechariah 5, what was found sitting in the midst of the ephah?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 describes a woman sitting in the midst of the ephah.

questions.question: What does the woman in the ephah represent according to the angel?
questions.explanation: The angel said the woman represents wickedness as stated in Zechariah 5:8.

questions.question: What was placed upon the mouth of the ephah containing the woman?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:8 says a weight of lead was cast upon the mouth of the ephah.

questions.question: What kind of wings did the two women that appeared have?
options: Wings like the wings of a stork
questions.correctAnswer: Wings like the wings of a stork
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 describes the two women as having wings like the wings of a stork.

questions.question: True or False: The two women lifted the ephah to the land of Shinar.
questions.explanation: The two women lifted the ephah, but the angel said it would be taken to build a house in the land of Shinar, not that the women themselves did this, as per Zechariah 5:9-11.

questions.question: Where did the angel say the ephah would be taken to build a house?
questions.explanation: The ephah was to be taken to the land of Shinar to build a house as stated in Zechariah 5:11.

questions.question: True or False: The flying roll's breadth was ten cubits.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:2 specifies the breadth of the flying roll as ten cubits.

medium.title: Zechariah Chapter 5 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Zechariah Chapter 5 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What is the angel's instruction to Zechariah in Zechariah 5:5?
options: Lift up thine eyes and see what goeth forth
questions.correctAnswer: Lift up thine eyes and see what goeth forth
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:5 states that the angel told Zechariah to lift up his eyes and see what is going forth, indicating a command to observe the vision carefully.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 5:6, what is the object that goes forth?
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 5:6, the angel explains that the object going forth is an ephah, which represents the likeness of wickedness throughout the earth.

questions.question: What does the woman sitting in the midst of the ephah represent, as explained in Zechariah 5:7-8?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:7-8 describes a woman sitting in the ephah, identified by the angel as wickedness, which is confined by a weight of lead placed upon the mouth of the ephah.

questions.question: How does Zechariah 5 teach about the consequences of stealing and false swearing?
options: They will be cut off according to the flying roll's curse
They will receive forgiveness without consequence
They will be rewarded for honesty
questions.correctAnswer: They will be cut off according to the flying roll's curse
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3-4 states that the curse goes forth over all the earth, cutting off those who steal or swear falsely, and consuming their houses, demonstrating the serious consequences of such sins.

questions.question: What practical lesson about integrity can be drawn from Zechariah 5:4?
options: Dishonesty leads to destruction of one’s household
Swearing falsely has no real consequences
questions.correctAnswer: Dishonesty leads to destruction of one’s household
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:4 warns that the curse will enter the house of the thief and the one who swears falsely, consuming it with timber and stones, teaching that dishonesty brings ruin to one’s home.

questions.question: What does the weight of lead placed on the mouth of the ephah symbolize in Zechariah 5:8?
options: Confining wickedness and preventing its spread
questions.correctAnswer: Confining wickedness and preventing its spread
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:8 shows that the weight of lead is cast upon the mouth of the ephah containing the woman symbolizing wickedness, implying an effort to contain or restrain evil.

questions.question: In Zechariah 5:9, what characteristic is given to the two women who come out with wings like a stork?
options: They have wings and carry the ephah between earth and heaven
They walk on the ground without wings
questions.correctAnswer: They have wings and carry the ephah between earth and heaven
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 describes two women with wings like a stork who lift the ephah between earth and heaven, symbolizing swift movement or removal of wickedness.

questions.question: Where do the two women carry the ephah, according to Zechariah 5:11?
options: To build it a house in the land of Shinar
questions.correctAnswer: To build it a house in the land of Shinar
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:11 states that the ephah is carried to the land of Shinar to build it a house and set it on its base, indicating the place where wickedness will be established.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 5:6 imply about wickedness and its presence in the world?
options: It is widespread and resembles the ephah going forth
It is rare and confined to one place
It is only in the hearts of a few
questions.correctAnswer: It is widespread and resembles the ephah going forth
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 5:6, the angel says the ephah going forth represents their resemblance through all the earth, indicating the wide presence of wickedness.

questions.question: Based on Zechariah 5:5-6, how does the vision teach us about spiritual discernment?
options: We must lift our eyes and perceive what God shows us about evil
Only leaders can see spiritual truths
questions.correctAnswer: We must lift our eyes and perceive what God shows us about evil
questions.explanation: The angel's command in Zechariah 5:5 to lift up the eyes and see, followed by the explanation in verse 6, teaches the importance of spiritual awareness and discernment regarding evil.

questions.question: What does the curse described in Zechariah 5:3 promise to those who swear falsely by God’s name?
options: They shall be cut off as on this side according to the curse
They will be forgiven without repentance
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be cut off as on this side according to the curse
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 states that every one who swears falsely by God's name will be cut off as on that side according to the curse, showing the seriousness of false swearing.

questions.question: How does the vision in Zechariah 5 encourage believers to live with integrity?
options: By showing that theft and false swearing bring destruction
By encouraging lying to avoid punishment
questions.correctAnswer: By showing that theft and false swearing bring destruction
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3-4 illustrate that sin such as stealing and false swearing results in being cut off and destruction, urging believers to pursue honesty and integrity.

questions.question: True or False: The flying roll described in Zechariah 5 is smaller than ten cubits in breadth.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:2 states that the flying roll is twenty cubits in length and ten cubits in breadth, so it is not smaller than ten cubits in breadth.

questions.question: True or False: The angel explains that the ephah going forth is a symbol of wickedness throughout the earth.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:6-8 identifies the ephah going forth as representing wickedness and includes a woman symbolizing wickedness inside it, confirming the symbolism.

questions.question: True or False: According to Zechariah 5:11, the ephah containing wickedness will be destroyed immediately upon arrival in the land of Shinar.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:11 says the ephah will be established and set upon its own base in the land of Shinar, implying a permanent setting rather than immediate destruction.

hard.title: Zechariah Chapter 5 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Zechariah Chapter 5.

questions.question: What creatures are described as having wings like the wings of a stork in Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 describes two women with wings like those of a stork lifting up the ephah, indicating the creatures are 'two women'.

questions.question: Where do the two women carry the ephah?
options: Between the earth and the heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Between the earth and the heaven
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 states the women lift the ephah 'between the earth and the heaven.'

questions.question: What question does Zechariah ask the angel about the ephah?
options: Whither do these bear the ephah?
questions.correctAnswer: Whither do these bear the ephah?
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 5:10, the prophet asks the angel, 'Whither do these bear the ephah?'

questions.question: According to the angel, where will the ephah be taken and established?
options: To build it a house in the land of Shinar
questions.correctAnswer: To build it a house in the land of Shinar
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:11 explains the ephah will be taken to build a house in the land of Shinar, where it will be established.

questions.question: What does the flying roll in Zechariah 5 symbolize?
options: The curse that goes forth over the whole earth
questions.correctAnswer: The curse that goes forth over the whole earth
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 identifies the flying roll as a curse going over the earth, punishing thieves and those who swear falsely.

questions.question: What consequence is promised to the thief and the one who swears falsely by God's name?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 states that everyone who steals or swears falsely shall be cut off according to the curse.

questions.question: What is the significance of the 'talent of lead' in the vision?
options: It represents the woman called wickedness
It symbolizes the weight of sin
It is a measure of grain
questions.correctAnswer: It represents the woman called wickedness
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:7-8 reveal that a talent of lead is lifted up and is the woman who sits in the ephah, representing wickedness.

questions.question: What does the ephah represent according to the angel in Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:6 states that the ephah is their resemblance through all the earth, symbolizing widespread wickedness.

questions.question: Which ancient land is mentioned as the place where the ephah will be set upon its own base?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:11 mentions the land of Shinar as the place where the ephah will have a house and be established.

questions.question: True or False: The flying roll is described as having a length of twenty cubits and a breadth of ten cubits.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:2 specifies the flying roll's length as twenty cubits and breadth as ten cubits.

questions.question: True or False: The curse in the flying roll is limited only to thieves and does not affect those who swear falsely.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 states the curse affects both those who steal and those who swear falsely by God's name.

questions.question: Which other biblical passage echoes the theme of wickedness personified as a woman, similar to Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:5-27 personifies folly or wickedness as a woman who seduces, echoing the woman called wickedness in Zechariah 5:7-8.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the theme of God's judgment on false swearing found in Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: James 5:12 echoes the admonition against swearing falsely, reflecting the curse on false swearers in Zechariah 5:3-4.

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the word 'ephah' used in Zechariah 5, and how does it contribute to the vision's symbolism?
options: A measure of volume, symbolizing sin's burden
A type of bird, symbolizing freedom
questions.correctAnswer: A measure of volume, symbolizing sin's burden
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'ephah' refers to a dry measure (approx. 22 liters), used here symbolically to contain wickedness, representing the burden of sin (Zechariah 5:6-7).

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in Zechariah 5 with the flying roll, the ephah, and the woman, and how does it function?
options: Allegory, to represent moral and spiritual realities
questions.correctAnswer: Allegory, to represent moral and spiritual realities
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5 uses allegory: the flying roll as a curse, the ephah as wickedness, and the woman symbolizing sin’s personification, to communicate spiritual truths (Zechariah 5:1-11).

theological.title: Zechariah Chapter 5 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Zechariah Chapter 5 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What dimensions are given for the flying roll seen by Zechariah?
questions.explanation: The dimensions of the flying roll are explicitly stated as twenty cubits in length and ten cubits in breadth in Zechariah 5:2.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 5, what happens to those who steal and swear falsely?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 states that every one that stealeth and sweareth shall be cut off according to the curse represented by the roll.

questions.question: What does the ephah symbolize in Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 5:8, the angel identifies the woman sitting in the midst of the ephah as wickedness.

questions.question: What is the fate of the house of the thief according to Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:4 states that the curse shall enter into the house of the thief and consume it with its timber and stones.

questions.question: How does Zechariah describe the women that come out with the ephah?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 describes the women as having wings like the wings of a stork as they lifted the ephah.

questions.question: What does the angel tell Zechariah about the destination of the ephah?
options: To build a house in the land of Shinar
questions.correctAnswer: To build a house in the land of Shinar
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 5:11, the angel says that the ephah will be carried to build a house in the land of Shinar.

questions.question: What attribute of God is demonstrated by the curse that goes forth over the whole earth?
questions.explanation: The curse that goes forth as a judgment for sin demonstrates God's attribute of justice, as seen in Zechariah 5:3.

questions.question: What theological insight can be drawn from Zechariah 5:5-6 and Zechariah 5:11 regarding sin and judgment?
questions.explanation: Both Zechariah 5:5-6 and 5:11 illustrate that the presence of wickedness leads to a certain judgment, highlighting the inevitability of God's justice.

questions.question: In what manner does the vision of the flying roll relate to the overarching theme of sin and its consequences in Scripture?
options: It shows God's indifference to sin
It exemplifies God's immediate judgment on sin
It illustrates the concept of redemption
questions.correctAnswer: It exemplifies God's immediate judgment on sin
questions.explanation: The flying roll represents God's imminent judgment against sin, as stated in Zechariah 5:3, which aligns with the biblical theme of God's justice.

questions.question: What role does the lead weight play in the vision described in Zechariah 5?
questions.explanation: The lead weight is cast upon the mouth of the ephah, signifying the weight of judgment upon wickedness as described in Zechariah 5:8.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth is revealed in Zechariah 5:4 regarding the impact of sin on one's household?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:4 indicates that the curse of sin will enter the house of the thief and consume it, illustrating the destructive nature of sin.

questions.question: What does the vision in Zechariah 5 suggest about the nature of wickedness?
questions.explanation: The vision of the ephah and the woman representing wickedness signifies that wickedness is pervasive throughout the earth, as indicated in Zechariah 5:6.

questions.question: How does the imagery of the flying roll connect to the concept of divine authority over creation?
questions.explanation: The flying roll as a representation of God's curse demonstrates His authority over creation and His judgment on sin, as seen in Zechariah 5:3.

questions.question: How does the vision of the two women relate to God's providence in dealing with evil?
questions.explanation: The two women lifting the ephah away signify God's active role in removing wickedness from the land, as described in Zechariah 5:9.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 5 teach about the ultimate fate of wickedness?
questions.explanation: The chapter's emphasis on the curse and the fate of the wicked indicates that wickedness will ultimately face judgment, as stated in Zechariah 5:3.
